programme.title: Warm + Cozy Winter

programme.title: Eggscellent Techniques
programme.desc: In this special technique episode, Frankie teaches us several methods for cooking a quintessential ingredient: eggs. The scramble, the omelet, the Benedict – learn to make them just the way you like them.

programme.title: Vintage
programme.desc: Frankie cooks his way back in time with his favorite vintage recipes. These oldie-but-goodie dishes are not only nostalgic and comforting, but they’ll also fill you up without costing you a pretty penny.

programme.title: Struggle Soup
programme.desc: Warm and hearty bowls of veggies, beans, pasta, and more, these soups will have you returning for seconds all year round. Frankie’s soup blueprints can turn everyday ingredients into extraordinary soups, with endless flavor opportunity.

programme.desc: In a sandwich, every component plays a role. With a supporting cast of fixin’s, and Frankie’s cost-saving homemade twists, these sandwiches just might steal the show.

programme.title: Crunchy

programme.title: Bring Your Own Lunch
programme.desc: Frankie is all about BYOL - bring your own lunch. It’s not only good for your wallet, it’s good for your health. Skip the vending machine and the cafeteria in favor of creative, cost effective and easy-to-transport midday meals.

programme.title: Let's Play Ball

programme.title: The Future is Flavor
programme.desc: Frankie harnesses the power of time to transform simple ingredients into flavorful goods that’ll stick around for a long time. Learn the basics of preserving, pickling & curing to make dinner anything but a struggle. It just takes a little patience.

programme.title: Pantry Pasta
programme.desc: Keep your pantry stocked with a few basic staples, and you’ll always have ingredients on hand for dinner, especially for pasta night. In this episode, Frankie creates delicious pasta dishes with the kitchen’s best-kept secret weapon – the pantry.

programme.title: Potato Variety Show
programme.desc: Today, Frankie’s slicing, mashing and smashing his way through the spud species, an essential staple for any Struggle kitchen. They’ve got so many talents and textures that whichever way you dig ‘em, potatoes will never let you down.

programme.title: Smash Burgers & A Slice in Los Angeles

programme.title: Tacos, Brats, & Biscuits in Austin

programme.title: Summer Seafood Smorgasbord

programme.title: Deluxe Dogs with Crusted Corn & Potatoes
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde puts a modern spin on a classic All-American cookout with his loaded hot dogs, spiced smashed potato salad, chorizo & corn nut crusted corn, and bangin’ banana pudding pops. Sparklers out for this spread!

programme.title: Top of the Line Steaks
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde is back to level up his steak game by grilling up a NY strip steak with roasted onions & poblanos, short ribs with chili paste and horseradish, and a grilled chateaubriand with charred broccolini. Steak your claim on these dishes!

programme.title: Grilled Chicken 3 Ways
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde amps up your chicken dishes by making smoky chicken wings, a whole roasted turmeric ginger chicken with tamarind sauce, and chicken patties grilled in banana leaves with chili lime noodles. A frosty lime rickey finishes it all off!

programme.title: Scrumptious Summer Sandwiches
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde channels his inner sandwich lover by making an angry lobster club with pepper aioli and grilled bacon, a lamb birria torta with avocado and ramen consomme, and his an Italian beef combo with chili crisp cheese sauce, and giardiniera.

programme.title: A Festive & Flavorful Christmas in July
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde dons his Santa hat & holiday garb while grilling up smoked ham & pineapple praline sliders, sweet potatoes with soy maple bacon, eggplant with labneh & cranberries, a holiday mezze plate, and a grilled coquito cocktail.

programme.title: The Perfection of Pork
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings the heat when it comes to making perfect pork dishes including a root beer glazed pork banh mi, chorizo fried rice, Filipino sausage stuffed long hot peppers, and round it all out with a spicy grilled pineapple sundae.

programme.title: Tempting Tasty Tacos
programme.desc: It’s always taco night at Chef Dale’s house! He turns up the heat with grilled salmon tacos with salsa verde & cauliflower escabeche, duck al pastor tacos with habanero pineapple salsa, & a smokey mushroom queso taco with truffle mole negro.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've searched high and low to bring together all the most entertaining animal clips for your viewing convenience. Moonwalking cats, the world's most guilty-looking dog, even a tortoise humping a shoe - if they're funny, you'll find them here.

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc: Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".nnBut they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: Super eye-catching! Herbivorous animal celebrity appears?! Delicate pets being snubby! They get angry if there's no air conditioning?! Genius horse trainer challenges the rapport between human and horses?! Fresh grass is so sweet that even humans love to eat it?! Growing up with sheep! Experts reveal the secrets of sheep?!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: A lone cow has gone wild and escaped into a neighbouring field.Dr. Matt has been called in to lend a hand. The heifer " went wild" two months ago and various tactics are employed to get Matt close enough to get a good shot with his dart gun. But the wary cow wins the first round and escapes. Matt decides to return another day.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Chief Inspector Cathy Hyde is on a warrant to access a property in Leigh, suspected of being involved in puppy trafficking. Cathy discovers two Jack Russell types and two Yorkshire Terriers. Tragically, they were too late one for one dog that had passed away and another has badly fractured leg. Will Cathy be able to provide the escape that these dogs desperately need?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Huang Yunong's Yunong Reptile Studio has an extraordinary passion for geckos and he regards every gecko as his own. He always feel sad when consumers buy them, just like saying goodbye to his own child. He always shares care knowledge in great detail, and cultivates concepts through his own experience to let more people know more about hem. He hopes that through "Cute Pets Coming", the overall gecko raising environment can continue to improve.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Inspector Herchy Boal teams up with the police to attend a property near Birmingham suspected of puppy farming. Tragically, for one puppy it was already too late, but she manages to rescue another 37 including 8 expectant mothers. Herchy discovers a range of breeds including Shih-Tzu’s, West Highland Terriers and Cavashons, but with many pups still yet to be born, how will they all get on?

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Dogs are mans’ most loyal friends. Their well-behaved and cute appearance is very soothing to our hearts. That’s why many people choose dogs to company with their family! There are many choices for companion dogs, but today's cute pet have well-developed muscles and a fierce look on their faces. But in fact, they love to act cute, making the contrast between their personality and appearance is extremely cute!nToday's Cute Pet Coming is going to subvert everyone’s impression on them! Follow us and get to know bulldogs ​​with a fierce face and gentle heart!

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've scoured the internet to bring you the most hilarious clips of Budgies (and other birds) on the planet, not so much -§who's a clever boy-¨ as -§who's a funny boy-¨! Flying fails, performing Parrots and the real life angry birds -V we've assembled the very best the web has to offer, guaranteed to make you laugh out loud.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The era of high housing prices shocks the masses. However, some are willing to live in the mountains for their beloved parrots, just to give them the best breeding environment. Parrots have a long lifespan and their IQ is comparable to that of a five-year-old child. How do you make them behave? Training is actually a good way, but how? "Melon seeds" are key to the goal. If you want to raise a parrot, there are in fact many restrictions on choosing the right one. How should I put it? Don’t miss "Cute Pet Guide"!

programme.desc: Max Mayfair is living the ‘good life’, running an exciting London nightclub and rubbing shoulders with the most glamourous crowds. That is, until the arrival of his unknown granddaughter, Barbara. To complicate matters, former mob associates; Mike and Armen, show up fleeing from New York having killed a made man. Now embroiled in a robbery in Portugal, Max gains a dangerous enemy when Barbara convinces him to steal millions from the Russian Mob. The only way to protect his family is to embrace the criminal ways he’d hoped to leave behind.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: Hayes Hodges, an attorney, takes up the offer of defending his friend Colonel Terry Childers, accused of ordering his squad to open fire on a group of demonstrators.

programme.title: The Commando
programme.desc: A DEA agent returns home with PTSD after a botched mission and must now protect his family from a home invasion when a recently freed convict and his henchmen come after their stash of millions hidden inside of the agent's home.

programme.title: The Competition
programme.desc: No information available

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page, a brilliant mother-daughter swindler team, target the city's wealthiest men. Max marries them and then sues for alimony after she catches them involved in an affair with Page.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - A Song To Kill For
programme.desc: Max Mayfair has it all; a beautiful girlfriend, Ava, a new London crime family, and thanks to his latest heist, a priceless diamond necklace. However, when mafioso Calbone’s henchmen catch up with Mike and Armen, determined to drag them back to New York to pay for their crimes, Max has everything to lose. Teaming up with his old friend, Marseille Mafia crime boss, Paul, Max hatches a plan to lure the New York Mafia to Mayfair.

programme.title: Operation Sea Wolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Johnny & Clyde
programme.desc: Johnny and Clyde are two serial killers who are on an endless crime spree. They decide to assemble a group of criminals and misfits to steal from Alana's casino and pull off the heist of the century.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - Serena's Game
programme.desc: Refusing to comply with Tommy’s demands, Max and Paul conspire to have the British gangster eliminated and Serena arrested. With Tommy dead and Serena in handcuffs, it appears as though Max has succeeded. His plan goes awry, however, when MI6 force Max to help Serena bring down her employers: the Russian mob. Torn between a life of crime with Serena or happiness with Ava, nothing is ever simple in the life of Max Mayfair.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Based on the true story, Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, is betrayed by one of the brothers. Seeking retribution, Valdez will risk it all to gain control of the Feliz cartel.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away from it all in a remote country house but when a mysterious injured man turns up on their doorstep telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - The Spyce Of Life
programme.desc: Returning from a romantic getaway with Ava, Max finds himself on the wrong side of the law yet again. Now blackmailed by MI6, Max must spy on two suspected terrorists; Aziz and Omar, who are regular customers at his club. Accompanied by his London crime family, Max breaks into Omar’s country estate and discovers his sinister plan. With everything on the line, Max must race to uncover a highly skilled hacker’s identity before it’s too late.

programme.title: The Legion
programme.desc: Noreno, a half-Roman, is entrusted with the mission of crossing the snowy mountains of Armenia, swarming with Parthian patrols, to seek help for his slowly dying men.

programme.title: Mojave Diamonds
programme.desc: A former MMA fighter and his brothers must rescue their kidnapped family from a dangerous crime syndicate after $50M of illegal diamonds gets stolen.

programme.title: Rollercoaster Renovation
programme.desc: Heide Park Soltau, a german adventure park, offers adrenaline junkies many attractions and rides. The biggest crowd puller is the Colossos wooden roller coaster - the highest and fastest wooden roller coaster in Europe. But over twenty million passengers in fifteen years are taking their toll. The ride closes temporarily and renovation work begins. It is a gigantic task - 1500 metres of track have to be renewed. A complete replacement of all wooden rails has never been done on a comparable facility before. It is a renovation of superlatives for 12.5 million euros. The team is working with the heavy components at heights of up to 60 metres. Safety technology and its correct application are vital. The reopening date is approaching and the pressure is mounting.

programme.desc: In the penultimate stretch of their journey, the four remaining celebrities must find and eat the fruits of the forest, carefully separating nutritious treats from any potentially deadly dinners. After that, they endure another stormy night and face their most extreme challenge yet - crossing a 200ft ravine one by one on a rope. Bear also tests their ability to start a fire using only bamboo poles, knives and flints, before deciding which three he will take through to the Bear Grylls: Mission Survive final.

programme.title: Highlights 6
programme.desc: The final three contestants Kelly Holmes, Mike Tindall and Vogue Williams fight it out to be crowned Bear's Mission Survivor. The first task sees the group split for the first time, as the contenders abseil down a 300ft waterfall one by one. They then have to build a camp without their usual supplies, before tucking into the evening's dinner - rats, which must be gutted and cooked. The next morning, the team tackles a dense mangrove swamp, following the sound of a distress signal in an attempt to reach assistant Scott, and with the end in sight, Bear has one final challenge in store.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E30 - Prince William And Prince Harry Prisoners Of Celebrity
programme.desc: Two young men who have had to cope with extraordinarily challenging events and circumstances as, together, they have gone on to change the face of the British royal family and carve meaningful roles for themselves in the modern world. Made in 1999 two years after the death of their mother, Princess Diana, this original and touching documentary examines the lives of the royal princes, the legacy of their mother, the responsibilities of being a royal - and what the future holds for them.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E06 - The Zambezi River Mystery
programme.desc: Carter's W.A.R. (Wild Animal Response) es la historia jamás contada de la búsqueda de un hombre para salvar su tierra natal, el continente más salvaje y peligroso del mundo, África. Desde cazadores furtivos fuertemente armados que masacran elefantes por sus colmillos hasta la matanza de rinocerontes por sus cuernos, el recurso más preciado de África está en peligro. ¿Puede un hombre descubrir la verdad y cambiar las cosas? Vea cómo Ivan Carter, detective de la fauna salvaje y cazador profesional, le lleva al interior del África real, a la primera línea de las guerras que se libran contra su fauna salvaje.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E01 - Meet Island Air
programme.desc: Miles de aventureros acuden a la isla de Kodiak para experimentar la naturaleza salvaje de Alaska a través de expediciones de caza, pesca y observación de la fauna, y Island Air Service hace realidad esas aventuras únicas en la vida. Volar con niebla, lluvia, nieve o aguanieve y trasladar a los aventureros, los lugareños, los suministros y los materiales a los rincones más remotos de la isla, todo es cuestión de un día para un piloto de monte de Kodiak y el personal y la tripulación de Island Air.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E02 - Fight or Flight
programme.desc: Durante un vuelo turístico rutinario, una fuerte tormenta obliga a los pilotos a luchar para mantener a salvo a sus pasajeros.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E05 - The Struggle
programme.desc: Laramy sigue atrapado en el Campamento Hell Hole, cuidando de la pierna de 7, y luchando por sobrevivir a las gélidas temperaturas sin comida.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E06 - On the Move
programme.desc: Laramy y Siete abandonan el campamento Hell Hole y emprenden de nuevo el camino. Se dirigen a una elevación más baja en busca de un lugar más permanente al que llamar hogar.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S01:E05 - Ron Smith Story
programme.desc: La historia real del encuentro de Ron Smith con un intrépido ciervo que les atacó a él y a su sobrino, Arik, mientras estaban pescando.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S01:E06 - Jackson Jordan
programme.desc: Este episodio presenta a Jackson Jordon y su estrecha escapada de la muerte en los bosques de Georgia tras el ataque de una manada de coyotes cuando sólo tenía 16 años.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E08 - Desert Mine Shafts
programme.desc: Tom y Kia se encuentran en el desierto explorando antiguos pozos mineros.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E09 - Lost Peg Leg Treasure
programme.desc: Tom y Kia buscan en el desierto el tesoro perdido de Pata de Palo.

programme.title: Diana: In Search of Happiness
programme.desc: 體驗對戴安娜公主的深入了解，這位20世紀的非凡女性。包含獨特的訪談和感人的片段，這幅肖像捕捉了她通往名聲的驚人之旅，以及她克服幾乎每天遭遇的情感和身體挑戰的能力。

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E30 - Prince William And Prince Harry Prisoners Of Celebrity
programme.desc: Two young men who have had to cope with extraordinarily challenging events and circumstances as, together, they have gone on to change the face of the British royal family and carve meaningful roles for themselves in the modern world. Made in 1999 two years after the death of their mother, Princess Diana, this original and touching documentary examines the lives of the royal princes, the legacy of their mother, the responsibilities of being a royal - and what the future holds for them.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E06 - The Zambezi River Mystery
programme.desc: Carter's W.A.R. (Wild Animal Response) es la historia jamás contada de la búsqueda de un hombre para salvar su tierra natal, el continente más salvaje y peligroso del mundo, África. Desde cazadores furtivos fuertemente armados que masacran elefantes por sus colmillos hasta la matanza de rinocerontes por sus cuernos, el recurso más preciado de África está en peligro. ¿Puede un hombre descubrir la verdad y cambiar las cosas? Vea cómo Ivan Carter, detective de la fauna salvaje y cazador profesional, le lleva al interior del África real, a la primera línea de las guerras que se libran contra su fauna salvaje.

programme.title: Jim Shockey's Uncharted - S01:E05 - Life and Death
programme.desc: Temperate Rain Forest Pt2. Jim comes face to face with a monster black bear in the coastal rain forest of the Pacific Northwest.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S05:E01 - Wildest Chase for Wild Boar
programme.desc: Manny está en los bosques de Florida cazando jabalíes con sus lanzas.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S05:E02 - The Island Boar
programme.desc: Manny se embarca en una aventura de caza de jabalíes en una pequeña isla en medio de un lago de Florida.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S05:E03 - Wild Boar the Hard Way
programme.desc: Es otro día en los bosques de Florida con God's Country Outfitters cazando feroces jabalíes.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S05:E04 - Handcatching Fish in the Dark
programme.desc: Manny se adentra en un mundo oscuro para capturar a mano el pez de agua dulce más grande de Florida.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E07 - Wild Australia
programme.desc: Más del 80% de las plantas, mamíferos, reptiles y ranas de Australia son exclusivos de este país y no se encuentran en ningún otro lugar del mundo. Los dingos salvajes, los juguetones canguros, los koalas de aspecto mimoso y los ornitorrincos juguetones son algunos de los animales salvajes más emblemáticos de Australia.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E08 - Masters of the Sky
programme.desc: Son muchas las palabras que describen las múltiples formas en que vuelan las aves: los pelícanos y los cernícalos remontan el vuelo, pero los búhos vuelan en silencio. Los loros vuelan en bandada, los buitres en enjambre y las águilas en picado. Los ojos precisos como radares escanean el suelo y las plumas ranuradas ajustan las trayectorias de vuelo cuando los halcones atacan. Pero, ¿cuál es el verdadero amo del cielo?

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E09 - Disguised
programme.desc: Ahora me ves... ahora no. Una mirada a los maestros del disfraz. Desde lagartos ocultos y arañas invisibles hasta gatos camuflados y calamares resplandecientes.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E10 - Micro Predators
programme.desc: Pueden ser pequeños, pero no se deje engañar: los microdepredadores pueden ser mortales. Desde la impresionante araña Portia, asesina en serie, hasta los cientos de especies de hormigas y el pez arquero, con su preciso disparo de gotas de agua para asegurar su presa, Wild Ones mira a través del microscopio para descubrir su verdadera letalidad.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E08 - Naturally Raw
programme.desc: Este episodio comienza en Costa Rica, en una increíble selva tropical. Aquí se elabora un delicioso chocolate con granos de cacao. La madre naturaleza se muestra en todo su esplendor, con cientos de especies de plantas y animales. Y luego a Kenia, donde los monos verdes serán nuestros guías turísticos en la Ciudad Perdida de Gedi, además de observar más de cerca la vida salvaje que vive muy cerca de las bulliciosas calles de Nairobi.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E09 - Naturally Invigorating
programme.desc: Islandia: hogar de lagos volcánicos y aguas termales y vistas monocromáticas. Y luego a Laos, en el Sudeste Asiático, con sus exuberantes selvas, cuevas subterráneas y búfalos de agua a lo largo del río Mekong.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E10 - Naturally Potent
programme.desc: Explore las montañas vírgenes de Laponia y siga hasta los inmaculados Alpes suizos. Como contraste, viajaremos a la provincia francesa de Champaña, cuna de los mejores vinos del mundo. Por último, Gibraltar atrae con su larga historia y sus extrañas y misteriosas cuevas.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E11 - Naturally Different
programme.desc: Las islas Shetland: hogar de 20.000 seres humanos, un millón de aves y el caballo más pequeño del mundo. A continuación, a una zona conocida por los lugareños como el Centro del Mundo, en la provincia sudoriental de Kazajstán. Desde allí iremos a las Montañas Amarillas, en China Central, a menudo llamadas La Venecia de China.

Determined to find out the real reasons behind the marriage, Jessica gets pulled into a whirlwind of events, putting her own life at risk. Is Carlos in trouble? Or is Grace a victim?
